title: Atlantic Trust Group LLC Trims Holdings in Apple Inc. (AAPL)

organizations.name: atlantic trust group llc trims holdings

text:
Atlantic Trust Group LLC cut its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 0.8% in the first quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 3,541,105 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 28,314 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for 2.6% of Atlantic Trust Group LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 2nd largest position. Atlantic Trust Group LLC owned about 0.07% of Apple worth $594,126,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
A number of other hedge funds have also recently bought and sold shares of the business. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the first quarter worth approximately $133,000. Smart Portfolios LLC acquired a new position in Apple in the first quarter worth approximately $134,000. Spectrum Financial Alliance Ltd LLC acquired a new position in Apple in the first quarter worth approximately $138,000. Macroview Investment Management LLC increased its holdings in Apple by 220.3% in the first quarter. Macroview Investment Management LLC now owns 900 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $151,000 after buying an additional 619 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Litman Gregory Asset Management LLC increased its holdings in Apple by 553.8% in the first quarter. Litman Gregory Asset Management LLC now owns 1,033 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $173,000 after buying an additional 875 shares during the last quarter. 58.62% of the stock is owned by institutional investors. A number of research firms recently commented on AAPL. Morgan Stanley restated a “buy” rating and issued a $245.00 price objective (up previously from $232.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, September 5th. DA Davidson restated a “buy” rating and issued a $265.00 price objective (up previously from $230.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, September 5th. DZ Bank restated a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, September 3rd. Canaccord Genuity restated a “buy” rating and issued a $250.00 price objective (up previously from $220.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, September 4th. Finally, Cascend Securities increased their price objective on Apple from $230.00 to $250.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Tuesday, September 4th. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, sixteen have issued a hold rating and thirty-one have given a buy rating to the company. The company presently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $233.12.
Shares of AAPL stock opened at $221.07 on Thursday. Apple Inc. has a 12 month low of $149.16 and a 12 month high of $229.67. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a current ratio of 1.31. The company has a market cap of $1,087.72 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 24.00, a P/E/G ratio of 1.95 and a beta of 1.32.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.98% and a return on equity of 43.50%. Apple’s quarterly revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter last year, the company posted $1.67 earnings per share. sell-side analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.74 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
The business also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, August 16th. Stockholders of record on Monday, August 13th were paid a $0.73 dividend. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, August 10th. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a dividend yield of 1.32%. Apple’s payout ratio is 31.70%.
In other news, Director Arthur D. Levinson sold 20,000 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Thursday, August 2nd. The shares were sold at an average price of $206.58, for a total value of $4,131,600.00. Following the sale, the director now owns 1,153,283 shares in the company, valued at $238,245,202.14. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available at this hyperlink . Also, insider Angela J. Ahrendts sold 6,568 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction on Friday, June 15th. The stock was sold at an average price of $188.81, for a total transaction of $1,240,104.08. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 79,476 shares in the company, valued at approximately $15,005,863.56. The disclosure for this sale can be found here .
